messages.content: 一輛汽車從靜止開始，10秒內行駛了120公尺的距離。在這段時間結束時，汽車的速度是多少？在達到這個速度後，汽車繼續加速5秒，從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍。最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍。在第二階段，汽車的加速度是多少？

function.name: kinematics_calculate_acceleration
function.description: Calculates the acceleration of an object under given conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the object. This is a float type value.

final_speed.description: The final speed of the object. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds it took the object to reach the final speed. This is a float type value.

distance.description: The distance in meters the object has traveled. This is a float type value.

function.name: kinematics_calculate_speed_from_rest
function.description: Calculates the speed of an object that starts from rest under a constant acceleration over a specified distance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

distance.description: The distance in meters the object has traveled. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds it took the object to travel. This is a float type value.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the object. This is a float type value.

message.reasoning:
We need to compute first part: car starts from rest, covers 120 m in 10 s. We need velocity at end of this period. Since initial speed zero, distance s = (1/2) a t^2. So a = 2s / t^2 = 2*120 / 100 = 240/100 = 2.4 m/s^2. Final speed v = a t = 2.4 * 10 = 24 m/s. So first part speed = 24 m/s.

Second part: car continues accelerating for 5 s, from 12 m/s to final speed which is twice the initial speed? Wait: "從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍" Means from 12 m/s accelerate to final speed that is twice the initial speed. But initial speed for second stage is 12 m/s? Actually says "從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍". Might mean starting at 12 m/s, final speed is twice the initial speed of the car? But initial speed of the car overall was 0. Twice that is 0. That doesn't make sense. Maybe they mean the initial speed of the second stage is 12 m/s, and final speed is twice that initial speed of second stage, so final speed = 24 m/s. But that would be same as first part final speed. But they also say "最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍" meaning final speed is twice the speed computed in first part. First part speed was 24 m/s, so final speed = 48 m/s. So second part: start at 12 m/s, end at 48 m/s after 5 s. So acceleration a = (v - u)/t = (48 - 12)/5 = 36/5 = 7.2 m/s^2. So answer: first part speed 24 m/s, second part acceleration 7.2 m/s^2.

But we might need to use the provided tool to calculate acceleration. The tool kinematics_calculate_acceleration expects initial_speed, final_speed, time, distance optional. We can call it with initial_speed=12, final_speed=48, time=5. That will compute acceleration. Let's do that.
